map.测量阅读速度，分析阅读效率，科学提升阅读能力: Measure reading speed, analyse reading efficiency and improve reading ability scientifically
map.📖 查看「阅读速度计算器 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Reading Speed Calculator User Guide"
map.阅读速度 = 阅读总量 ÷ 阅读时长。: Reading speed = total amount read ÷ reading time.
map.英文约按词（WPM = 词数 ÷ 分钟）: English is usually counted in words (WPM = words ÷ minutes)
map.中文常按字/分钟: Chinese is usually counted in characters per minute
map.（或按 100 字 ≈ 1 分钟基准折算）。理解率 = 答对题数 ÷ 总题数，用: (or converted on the basis of 100 characters ≈ 1 minute). Comprehension = correct answers ÷ total questions, used to correct for reading fast without understanding.
map.成人中文正常阅读约 300–500 字/分钟，熟练速读可超 1000 字/分钟。: Adults normally read Chinese at about 300-500 characters per minute; skilled speed readers can exceed 1000 characters per minute.
map.理解率低于 70% 时，速度数据参考价值低，应降速精读。: When comprehension drops below 70%, the speed figure is of little reference value and you should slow down and read carefully.
map.本工具纯本地计算，用于自我训练追踪，非标准化测评。: This tool computes entirely locally; it is for tracking your own training, not a standardized assessment.
map.在上方输入文章总字数（可从文档统计功能获取）: Enter the total number of characters above (get it from a document word count)
map.点击「开始计时阅读」按钮，开始正常阅读: Click the timed reading button and start reading normally
map.读完后点击「完成阅读」，系统自动计算阅读速度: When you finish, click finish reading and the speed is worked out automatically
map.快速估算区可根据已知速度计算任意字数文章的阅读时间: The quick-estimate box calculates reading time for any text length from a known speed
map.历史记录功能会自动保存最近20次测试结果: History automatically keeps the most recent 20 results
map.首次测量建议用熟悉的文章类型，了解自己的基准速度: For your first measurement use a familiar kind of text to find your baseline speed
map.不同类型文章速度不同：小说 > 科普 > 专业文献: Speed differs by text type: fiction > popular science > specialist literature
map.理解率比速度更重要，建议保持70%以上理解率: Comprehension matters more than speed; keep it above 70%
map.每天练习15-30分钟，持续2-3周可见明显提升: Practise 15-30 minutes a day and you will see clear improvement after 2-3 weeks
map.避免默读（在心里念出文字），这是限制速度的主要因素: Avoid subvocalizing (saying the words in your head), the main thing holding your speed back
map.意群阅读：以词组/短语为单位阅读，而非逐字阅读: Read in sense groups: take in word groups rather than single characters
map.视线移动练习：练习快速移动视线，减少回视: Eye-movement drills: move your eyes faster and cut regressions
map.扩大视幅：训练一眼看到更多文字: Widen your span: train yourself to take in more text at a glance
map.限时阅读：设定时间限制，强迫自己加快速度: Timed reading: set a limit so you have to speed up
map.引导物法：用手指或笔引导视线，保持节奏: Pacing: guide your eyes with a finger or a pen to keep rhythm
map.古诗词文：约 100-200 字/分钟: Classical poetry and prose: about 100-200 characters/min
map.有效阅读速度 = 阅读速度 × 理解率: Effective reading speed = reading speed × comprehension rate
map.例如：阅读速度600字/分，理解率80%，有效速度=480字/分: For example: 600 characters/min at 80% comprehension gives an effective speed of 480 characters/min
map.不要盲目追求速度，保持理解率在70%以上更有价值。: Do not chase speed blindly; keeping comprehension above 70% is worth more.
map.📚 深度解析：由阅读总量与耗时估算阅读速度（中文字/分或英文 WPM），辅助阅读: 📚 In-depth: estimates reading speed (Chinese characters/min or English WPM) from the amount read and the time taken, helping assess reading efficiency.
map.中英区分：字/分或词/分。: Chinese or English: characters/min or words/min.
map.示例：30 分钟读 9000 中文字，速度 300 字/分。: Example: 9000 Chinese characters read in 30 minutes is 300 characters/min.
map.中英怎么算？: How are Chinese and English reckoned?
map.中文按字/分，英文按词/分(WPM)。: Chinese in characters/min and English in words/min (WPM).
map.为平均估算，忽略回读与停顿。: It is an average estimate that ignores re-reading and pauses.
map.阅读训练与效率自评。: Reading training and self-assessment of efficiency.
